headline: Built by Women. For Women.
body: Designed by busy, stylish women for busy, stylish women.
“You can tell how smart people are by what they laugh at.” ― Tina Fey
Some decisions are easy: The Evangeline Jardigan in Lustre Knit Tweed, the Rumi pant in Aubergine, and the Vittoria bag by Visonà in Chocolate Suede.
Samantha saw her oldest friends once a year and picked up exactly where they’d left off—as if no time had passed, and as if all of it had.
Some decisions are easy: The Yiyan Blazer and Bia Trouser in Sequin Herringbone suiting, and the Tatum Top and Bia Trouser in Redwood Plissé.

“At the start of every new season, whether that season is tied to the changing calendar or a new project, I go back to one question: What can I wear that will bring out my best?” For artist and regular M Dash contributor Maayan Zilberman, it comes down to this: what you wear should fit the season of life you’re actually in. Read her latest M Dash via the link in our bio, and see how she turns pieces she already owns into seven looks.
The M.M. Holiday Gift Shop is now open. Discover the gifts every woman will actually want to unwrap this season.
Samantha finished her gift shopping early, largely because every present she bought was something she also wanted for herself. A generous spirit, technically.
Some decisions are easy: the 100% Cashmere Davina sweater in Butterscotch, and the Jumi skirt in Artisan Weave.

headline: Slow North Signature 3-Wick Candle - Eucalyptus + Lavender
body: Transform your space into a serene retreat with our new Signature 3-Wick Candle in Eucalyptus + Lavender — a sweet, calming blend designed to fill larger spaces with soft, natural fragrance and a warm, even glow. Topped with a black metal lid. Hand-poured in Austin, Texas , this candle is crafted with 100% soy wax and pure essential oils , offering a clean, non-toxic burn you can feel good about. Fragrance Profile: Top Note: Eucalyptus – Crisp and clarifying, it opens the senses and clears the mind. Heart Note: Lavender – Soft and floral, it soothes tension and invites deep exhalation. Why You’ll Love It: Triple wick design for an even, radiant burn Sized for larger spaces or longer rituals Made with pure essential oils and natural soy wax

headline: O'Hara "The Editor" Blazer - Everyday Crepe :: Hazy Mauve
body: The O'Hara is the cool, artsy girl from high school who grew up to be an executive—in blazer form. It features a slightly boxy cut and long hemline, balanced by a slim fit through the shoulders. Dress it down with jeans, or wear it with trousers for a modern take on suiting. This Everyday Crepe version is ideal for travel, thanks to its wrinkle-resistance and machine-washability. Made in China with fabric from Japan.

headline: Bixby | Reading Glasses
body: Meet Bixby, the bold statement condensed into a smaller package. Bixby is designed with the same DNA as other Caddis favorites, yet still, its own animal and designed for slightly smaller faces.

headline: Tinsley Wide-Leg Trouser - Luxe Flex Suiting :: Dark Forest
body: These timeless trousers strike the perfect balance between wide-leg and streamlined. Crafted from our machine-washable Flex Suiting material, the Tinsleys sit smoothly above the hips and have roomy side pockets. The curtained waistband is borrowed from traditional men’s suiting pants to offer crisp structure. Made in Portugal with fabric from Portugal.

headline: Aliza Travel Vest - OrigamiTech :: Aubergine
body: Structured yet playful, the button-up Aliza vest features a waist-defining hem split. Made from our signature OrigamiTech fabric, it’s washable, wrinkle-resistant, and easy to pack. Perfect for those days that start with a 5am ride to the airport and end with rooftop cocktails.

headline: Inoui Editions Scarf 80 - Wool :: Gustav Navy
body: Each Scarf 80 Gustav showcases unique and colorful prints crafted by the talented Inoui designers. Suitable for any situation, it remains a timeless element in the wardrobes of women. Whether you wear it as a statement piece or as a complement to your outfit, the Scarf 80 Gustav adds the final touch to your look.

headline: Nonchi Cashmere Resort Cardigan - 100% Virgin Baby Cashmere :: Black
body: A relaxed cardigan with a deep neckline and ribbed cuffs, knitted entirely from 100% Virgin Baby Cashmere.

headline: Slow North Hello Sunshine Signature Candle - Grapefruit + Geranium + Lime
body: Elevate your mood and brighten your space with the vibrant and joyful essence of our Hello Sunshine candle. Crafted meticulously in Austin, Texas, this natural candle promises to bring a serene retreat right into your living space. Fragrance Profile: Top Note: Bright Grapefruit - A burst of citrusy grapefruit that brings a fresh and uplifting energy, perfect for starting your day with positivity. Heart Note: Floral Geranium - Delicate and balanced, the floral notes of geranium add elegance and a soothing undertone to the vibrant grapefruit. Base Note: Zesty Lime - The crisp and tart aroma of lime provides a refreshing finish, grounding the fragrance with its lively and invigorating presence.

headline: Sia Cascade Dress - Printed Silk Charmeuse Blend :: Fine Line Floral
body: From gallery opening to dinner reservation, the Sia—inspired by the Priya—is there to help you show up. Its bias cut gives it a liquid, moves-with-you drape, while the cowl neck and extended cap sleeve keep it polished. This version arrives in a limited-edition Fine Line Floral print on a silk-charmeuse blend with a hint of shimmer. And yes, it’s machine-washable. Stylist tip: Due to the sheer nature of the dress, we recommend layering the Commando Slip underneath the Sia for extra coverage.

headline: Skye Stationery Set
body: *Featured in NYT Wirecutter's gift guides for best host gifts and best gifts under $50 and 6 gifts that have really wowed us lately. Hand painted card set. This s et contains 6 unique cards with matching envelopes. Cards are b lank inside. Each card is hand painted on large pieces of card stock before foil stamping on one of our antique foil presses. The result is an entirely one-of-a-kind card. Card size: 5.5 x 4.25" folded card Made in the USA in Des Moines, Iowa. Packaged in our signature die-cut box perfect for gifting.

headline: Aditi Boardroom Dress - Knit Suiting :: Charcoal Brown
body: This streamlined, sleeveless sheath gives off an unequivocal I’m-in-charge vibe. From its powerful V-neck to its meticulous construction, the Aditi is classic, sophisticated, and unbelievably comfortable, just the way we like it. The cherry on top? It’s also machine washable. Stylist tip: This color is particularly flattering to those with Autumn/Winter color palettes.

headline: Evangeline "The Duchess" Blazer - Boucle :: Burgundy / Ivory
body: Our take on the iconic lady jacket. Blends the sharpness of a jacket with the stretch and softness of a cardigan (hence, “jardigan”). Features a boucle tweed, a cropped fit, bold buttons, and a black ribbed trim.

headline: Hera Knot Top - Light Printed Jersey :: Leaf Line Fern
body: Meet the Hera: a relaxed, sleeveless top with a box tie at the right shoulder that brings just the right amount of attention. The crew neck keeps it grounded, while the asymmetrical cut adds interest. Here in our tried and true Light Printed Jersey, which is stretchy, lightweight, and machine-washable. Pro tip: Tuck the front into a wide-leg trouser and leave the rest loose. Leaf Line Fern features an oxford-blue background — a gray-leaning navy — with ivory ferns.

headline: Bia Pleated Trouser - Plisse :: Redwood
body: Prepare yourself: the Bia is one of those stand-out styles people stop you to ask about on the street. Wide legs and double front pleats make for a perfectly slouchy silhouette. This edition of the Bia arrives in plissé with finely pleated texture and a soft sheen. On trend now, effortlessly chic always. (And machine-washable.)

headline: Becca Pointelle Tee - Cotton Silk Knit :: Deep Teal
body: The ease of a T-shirt meets the elegance of a sweater. The Becca is simple to style, but pointelle detailing plus wide ribbing at the cuffs, neckline, and hem make it anything but ordinary. Not to mention the fact that this lightweight, cloud-soft cotton-silk blend is genuinely divine. Made in China with fabric from China.

headline: Malda Double-Breasted Coat - Felted Wool Cashmere :: Dark Gray Melange
body: A double breasted coat with a thoughtfully designed notch collar that carries you from the first cold snap to final freeze of the season in style. Crafted in an ultra-warm Italian wool-cashmere blend in a versatile gray melange, the Malda falls past the knee, and features a self-tie you can cinch your way, so it's as sharp open as it is belted.

headline: Yiyan "The Executive" Blazer - Sequin Herringbone :: Brown Multi
body: The Yiyan blazer features a tailored fit and elongated silhouette. With deep pockets for your essentials, this version arrives in a sequin herringbone, the classic fish-bone weave shot through with subtle sparkle. Wear it with the matching Bia trouser for a full suit, or style with jeans to elevate your everyday look.

headline: Inoui Editions Scarf 130 - Silk Modal :: Astrologie Orange
body: Each Square 130 showcases unique and colorful prints crafted by our talented designers. Suitable for any situation, it remains a timeless element in the wardrobes of both men and women. Whether you wear it as a statement piece or as a complement to your outfit, the Square Scarf 130 adds the final touch to your look. Made in India.

headline: Malley Fitted Tee - Ribbed Pima Cotton :: Peacock
body: With a streamlined silhouette and simple crew neck, the Malley is a buttery-soft classic that feels as if it’s been in your closet all along. It’s made from organic Pima cotton and features a fine ribbed knit, so it’s a far cry from your average tee.

headline: Aniya Crop Jacket - Tropical Wool :: Peacock
body: It's the jacket that goes everywhere, and looks good doing it. Let this collarless, cropped jacket transport you to Paris (warm baguette in hand) the moment you put it on. With self-covered buttons and flap pockets, this version comes in our breathable Tropical Wool, 100% wool in a refined flat weave.

headline: Maisie Dress - Recycled WonderTex :: Black
body: The Maisie dress features a wide boat neck, decorative waist draping, a subtle side slit, and a commute-ready 4-way stretch. Designed with the covert comfort of Wondertex, the Maisie is also wrinkle resistant and fully machine-washable.

headline: Annika Fancy Tee - Plisse :: Redwood
body: Meet the T-shirt’s ambitious older sister, Annika. A relaxed fit and sleeves with full upper-arm coverage keep it polished but effortless. This version comes in plissé, finely pleated for texture and a subtle sheen—and it’s 100% machine-washable (seriously). Made in China with fabric from China.

headline: Tatum Button-Down Shirt - Printed Silk Charmeuse Blend :: Garden Haze
body: The Tatum shirt is our take on a classic, luxe button-down. What makes this one extra special? The thin placket creates a more elegant look, and the tall sleeve cuff can be flipped up for some unique flair, while the weaving method used to make the silk charmeuse fabric allows for extra luster and shine in the front. Plus, it’s 100% machine-washable. This version of the Tatum features a limited edition print by Karolina York. Garden Haze features a dark navy background with multiple colors blended throughout.

headline: Farren Swing Dress - Luxe Flex Suiting :: Dark Forest
body: This easy everyday dress features design details that make it extra special: a mock neck, topstitch detailing, and a just-right A-line shape that’s relaxed but not poofy. Now available in our beloved Luxe Flex Suiting by popular demand. Fabric from Portugal.

headline: Yiyan "The Executive" Blazer - Heritage Tweed :: Bordeaux Multi
body: The Yiyan blazer features a tailored fit and elongated silhouette. Featuring signature back-seam knit panels so you can stretch with ease and deep pockets for your essentials, this version arrives in our Heritage Tweed, a richly-textured wool blend. Wear it with the Bia trouser or Meredith dress for a suit, or style with jeans to elevate your everyday look.

headline: Evangeline "The Duchess" Blazer - Lustre Knit Tweed :: Multi
body: Our take on the iconic lady jacket. The Evangeline blends the sharpness of a jacket with the stretch and softness of a cardigan (hence, “jardigan”). This version is made from a lustrous knit tweed with high texture and subtle shine, along with bold buttons.

headline: Nonchi Resort Cardigan - 100% Virgin Baby Cashmere :: Derby Grey
body: The Resort Cardigan in soft grey envelops the body in gentle structure, providing warmth that feels weightless. Ribbed cuffs and a deep neckline frame the form with ease and intention. The serene grey tone recalls mist-laden mornings, timeless and soothing, a garment to return to again and again.

headline: Inoui Editions Scarf 70 - Wool :: Les Cheris Red
body: Les Cheris brings together aristocratic cats and dandy dogs, perfectly settled in a geometric setting as graphic as a red carpet. Between impeccable lines and irresistible little faces, it plays the chic card: a guaranteed "stroke of paw" effect. Made in India.

headline: Camille Sway Dress with Scallop - Printed Silk Charmeuse Blend :: Garden HazeCamille Sway Dress - Printed Silk Charmeuse Blend :: Garden Haze
body: The Camille dress is proof that an easy dress can still turn heads. A bias cut gives it a liquid, moves-with-you drape, while scalloped edges at the neckline and armholes add just the right amount of detail. Wear it to the office under a blazer or jardigan, then let it stand on its own after dark. Crafted from our drapey, machine-washable Printed Silk Charmeuse Blend in Garden Haze. This version of the Camille features a limited edition print by Karolina York. Garden Haze features a dark navy background with multiple colors blended throughout.

headline: Frisson Fur Kelly Jacket - Cashmere/Faux Fur :: Navy
body: A cropped jacket with genuine fox fur, removable to suit the day. Patch pockets and ribbed cuffs keep it grounded.

headline: Didion Drape Top - Lace Flora :: Black
body: This M.M. classic, here in a limited edition, delicate corded lace with light-pink lining, features a relaxed silhouette that looks like a blouse and feels like your favorite T-shirt. Try wearing it under a suit, tucked into a pencil skirt, or loose over slim pants.

headline: Mejia Tapered Pant - Knit Suiting :: Charcoal Brown
body: These machine-washable, wrinkle-resistant trousers made from our super-soft knit suiting sit smoothly above the hips and look tailored without feeling tight. A straight fit through the thigh and slight taper at the calf create an elongating effect, while deep pockets offer plenty of room to stash essentials. Stylist tip: This color is particularly flattering to those with Autumn/Winter color palettes.

headline: Valencia Power Dress - Luxe Flex Suiting :: Dark Forest
body: The Valencia is one of those dresses you’d spot on the likes of Olivia Pope, Claire Underwood, Alicia Florrick, etc. In other words, this mockneck style is meticulously tailored and knows how to command a room. Our luxurious Flex Suiting fabric is simultaneously comfortable and structured, while the cross-front slit provides understated elegance. Made in Portugal with fabric from Portugal.

headline: Axam Layering Turtleneck - Ribbed Pima Cotton :: Tuscan Red
body: Made from super-soft Peruvian Pima cotton, this fine-ribbed turtleneck is a cool-weather wardrobe staple. Thanks to a fitted silhouette, it’s the perfect thing to layer under blazers and sweaters or tuck into high-waisted pants and skirts.

headline: Estelle Earrings :: Gold
body: The earrings you wear when you want to make a subtle statement. Made with gold-plated stainless steel, and topped off with a pearl.

headline: Everly Belt :: Cement/Silver
body: The Everly is our answer to the statement belt trend. Made from a cream leather and featuring silver hardware, it makes even your simplest of outfits more interesting.
